rca: Wallet was debited exactly once (Rs 2000); the original IMPS payout failed for a transient bank-side reason, so the system automatically retried the same withdrawal via NEFT per design (razorpay.retry-enabled=true). That NEFT retry was stuck in 'processing' with Razorpay because the day's NEFT settlement window had already closed when it was submitted -- Razorpay's own status said it would be picked up in the next window. A reversal notification for the original failed attempt arrived later but was correctly ignored, since crediting the wallet back would have double-paid the CSP once the in-flight retry completed (RAZORPAY_REVERSED_IGNORED_RETRY_IN_FLIGHT). This same double-credit risk was hit once before (a June 2026 incident) and this ignore-while-retry-in-flight behaviour is the fix, not a new bug.
issue: Withdrawal appeared stuck because the auto-retry (NEFT, after the original IMPS attempt failed) was waiting out a closed bank settlement window -- not a lost payment, resolves on its own within the stated ETA.
